latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of TensorsLab Image Skill.
- Generate and edit images with TensorsLab models (text-to-image, image-to-image).
- Supports advanced tasks: avatar creation, watermark removal, object erasure, face replacement, and more.
- Automatic prompt enhancement for high-quality results, with progress updates and easy local file saving.
- Flexible model selection and resolution options.
- Requires TENSORSLAB_API_KEY environment variable for use.
